question: Do home or parked cars report a stale non-zero Waiting (agent-reported issue 1)?
code_finding: TrafficControl.cs sets Waiting only in the movement-proposal loop, before AdvanceVehicle; FinishHome and the EnteringParking->Parking transition did not clear it, and non-moving cars get no proposals. A car accelerating from standstill gains 0.27*0.05=0.0135 tiles/s per tick, below the 0.02 waiting threshold, so a queued car released within one creeping tick of its journey end arrives with its queue wait.

replay_candidate_v20_77_source.note: WaitProbe per-tick bookkeeping slows the run; the 120 s wall cap stopped it, so this is not a replay result

regression: SimulationChecks 'arrival home or in a bay clears the current wait': failed before the fix with 'Home car keeps no stale queue wait: waiting=12.05'; passes after (78 suites).
gameplay_effect: Waiting feeds traffic-light phase weighting only for moving cars. A car leaving home or a bay previously started from any stale value; it now starts at 0. reward-fixture-v5, environment and five-map checks are unchanged after the fix. No stale case was observed in practice, so measured effect is nil on these games.
meanWaiting: Observation meanWaiting is the mean over all cars ever spawned of cumulative TotalWaiting (seconds); not stale, monotonic, includes never-moved cars. No consumer in training/ or gp4 evolved_rules. Documented, not changed.
